title: Strategic initiative starved of attention
accepted_explanation: Middle managers resist the new strategy.
observations: Senior leaders announce the initiative as a top priority.
Budget and executive meeting time remain concentrated on legacy business.
Managers are evaluated mainly on legacy performance.
Executives repeatedly postpone decisions required by the new initiative.
participant_claims: Executives say middle management lacks commitment.
researcher_interpretations: Leadership allocation decisions may contradict stated priorities.
assumptions: Verbal sponsorship is sufficient evidence of leadership commitment.
missing_evidence: Executive attention and resource allocation over time.
